description: This SwiftUI view component manages the interface for setting wake words used in voice activation within an app. It provides UI for adding, removing, resetting defaults, and editing trigger words, and handles persistent storage and synchronization with the app model.

classes.name: VoiceWakeWordsSettingsView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for configuring voice wake words, including adding, deleting, resetting, and persisting trigger words, with synchronization support.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds an empty trigger word to the list.

methods.name: removeWords
methods.description: Removes trigger words at specified offsets and resets to defaults if the list becomes empty.

methods.name: binding
methods.description: Provides a Binding<String> for a specific trigger word index to facilitate editing.

methods.name: commitTriggerWords
methods.description: Saves trigger words persistently, sanitizes them, and updates the global wake words asynchronously.
